metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skill collection — domain-organized monorepo by donggu

plugins.name: donggu-docs
plugins.description: Document & deck authoring — zero-dependency single-HTML slide decks (make-ppt) and card-news / carousel sets rendered to PNG + PDF from an editable JSON spec (make-card-news).

plugins.name: donggu-sns
plugins.description: SNS and YouTube editorial operations — portable channel-native text authoring, AI-image generation, YouTube planning, and gated publishing.

plugins.name: donggu-media
plugins.description: YouTube media helpers — get-youtube-scripts is a captions-only fallback for source-track selection and 429 avoidance; save-youtube-source creates the Obsidian reference note. No audio transcription.

plugins.name: donggu-apply
plugins.description: Freelance proposal auto-apply — capture login session, crawl a project brief + client pre-questions, draft a proposal from the portfolio Supabase DB (SSOT), autofill the apply form, and gate submission behind a Discord HITL button. apply-wishket skill (Wishket); DRY-RUN preview unless explicitly submitted; structured to add more platforms.

plugins.name: donggu-research
plugins.description: Beginner-friendly research workflows — learn how AI and AX change manufacturing, finance, commerce, logistics, and other real industries, one company and three numbers at a time.
